caseNameFull: Charles Barr v. A. A. McCorkle, Warden and Keeper of the Tennessee State Penitentiary
attorneys: Mr. Grover McCormick for appellant. Mr. William H. Swiggart for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Motion to transfer the appeal to the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit denied upon the authority of the act of February 13, 1925, c. 229, sec. 13,43 Stat. 942, and appeal dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of the act pf February 13, 1925, c. 229, sec. 6 (a), 43 Stat. 940, and sec. 13, supra.
